confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain, especially for July peak season. The FX value (0.6955 for 2026-10-15) comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly; the 2026-10-16 figure in that summary was not used because its publication could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Canggu and similar Bali tourist areas (Seminyak, Ubud), adjusted for Canggu's Western cafe and bar pricing and July high-season demand. Drink anchors use typical Bali restaurant and bar markups, with wine and cocktail set relative to beer.
